title: After Hours Pavilion - low-CPU six-lane patch plan
status: plan only: no Rack patch was built, loaded, auditioned or rendered
owner: Codex integrates and may revoice; parameter ranges below are suggestions, not loaded values
principles: One poly PVX carries the displaced bell/reed lead and sparse counterline; one mono PVX carries the gentle bass.
Percussion is a few soft oscillator/noise/envelope/VCA supports; the quiet middle stays quiet.
One restrained clean Spoon Bender may provide a small dark room.
No firmware emulation, no giant voice bank, no GPU/audio/image sampling prerequisite and no DC pulses.

lanes.name: kick
lanes.plan: Soft off-beat thump; some expected downbeats are intentionally absent.

lanes.name: snare
lanes.plan: Soft rim/brush noise on displaced beats; no backbeat grid.

lanes.name: hat/texture
lanes.plan: Sparse short ticks; absent in the quiet middle.

lanes.name: lead
lanes.plan: Displaced bell/reed PVX phrase with long rests and a soft attack.

lanes.name: bass
lanes.plan: Gentle mechanical mono bass, short repeated notes.

lanes.name: counterline/atmosphere
lanes.plan: Sparse high counterline, optional small Spoon Bender return.

PVX_lead.cpu_note: One instance, no bell sample bank.

percussion.cpu_note: Small and algorithmic; no sampled lounge kit.

space.cpu_note: Low mix; quiet middle stays dry if preferred.

routing_intent: Lanes 4 and 6 to one poly PVX; lane 5 to one mono PVX.
Lanes 1-3 to the soft percussion supports.
Lane 6 may take a small Spoon Bender send; no global wash or heavy modulation.
No sidechain network and no external sequencer.

PVX_lead.note: Bell/reed colour, soft and slightly unstable; do not turn it into a bright solo.

PVX_bass.note: Gentle and mechanical; keep note lengths short.

percussion.note: Soft and sparse; the quiet middle deliberately has no hats or backbeat.

space.note: Small dark room; reduce or bypass in the quiet middle.

gorgon_bridge: Gorgon poly pitch12/gates11/velocity3 are the real bridge outputs from the score. Suggested velocity goes to a VCA, not to PVX input2.
pvx_input2: PVX input2 is external AUDIO, not velocity. Any velocity suggestion in this plan belongs on a VCA.
limits: No patch was loaded or auditioned here.
codex_discretion: All machine numbers are neutral score slots and may be replaced.
Parameter ranges are starting suggestions only; Codex owns the real patch and audio review.
The quiet middle may bypass the Spoon Bender entirely.
